method: A grid cell belongs to the area whose geoBoundaries boundary contains the cell centre. A variable is covered when at least 50% of the variable's cells in the area's bounding box belong to the area and carry a usable series. The NASA analysis grids used here cover South Asia only, so countries outside their extent have no measured coverage and show 'No data'. Coverage is also measured only for ADM0 countries and ADM1 areas; ADM2 polygons are usually smaller than these grids. No weather value is invented for an area that lacks one.

dry-spell.name: Dry spells
dry-spell.rule: Covered when at least 50% of the variable's grid cells in the area's bounding box lie inside the boundary and carry a value for 10+ years from 2014.
